AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

WARRANTS

Warrants

2.
RECEIVE AND FILE REVISED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE MONTHS ENDING NOVEMBER 30, 2023
Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and file financial statements for the month ending Revised November 30, 2023.
Staff Report
3.
DONATION FROM RESIDENTS MARK AND TAMMY TUCKER
Recommendation:  That the City Council accept an unsolicited donation of $500 from residents Mark and Tammy Tucker.
Staff Report
4.
SPECIAL EVENT APPLICATION FOR LUNADA BAY AND PALOS VERDES LITTLE LEAGUES ANNUAL OPENING DAY PARADES SCHEDULED FOR SATURDAY, FEBRUARY 24, 2024
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Special Event Applications submitted by Lunada Bay and Palos Verdes Little Leagues for their Opening Day Parades on February 24, 2024. Approve the Special Event Applications, for the Lunada Bay Little League and Palos Verdes Little Leagues Annual Opening Day Parades Saturday, February 24, 2024, from 7:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., and waive reimbursement of staff overtime costs for hours worked outside their regular schedule consistent with past practice.
Staff Report
Revised Staff Report
5.
APPROVE AN AGREEMENT WITH THE PALOS VERDES PENINSULA UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT FOR TRANSFER OF FUNDS FOR THE PARCOURSE
Recommendation: That the City Council authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to sign an agreement to transfer to the Peninsula Unified School District donated funds the City receives for maintenance of the Parcourse Fitness Circuit and execute any other necessary documents to achieve such purpose.
Staff Report
Revised Staff Report
6.
PLANNING COMMISSION ACTION MINUTES
Recommendation: That the City Council receive and file.
1-16-24 PC Mtg
7.
REVISED CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-2024 THROUGH FISCAL YEAR 2027-2028
Recommendation: That the City Council approve the revised proposed Capital Improvement Program (CIP) for fiscal year (FY) 2023-2024 through FY 2027-2028.
Staff Report
8.
ADOPT RESOLUTIONS R24-02 APPROPRIATING UNENCUMBERED GENERAL FUND FOR SERVICES PROVIDED BY FORUM INFO TECH
Recommendation: Recommendation: That the City Council adopt Resolution No. R24-02 to appropriate $47,516 in unencumbered General Fund (01) for Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Forum Info Tech for Information Technology Services
Staff Report
PRESENTATION
9.
YOUTH ADVISORY COUNCIL
OLD BUSINESS
10.
PROPOSED ORGANIZATIONAL CHART VERSION 3
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council review the proposed organizational chart, version 3, and provide directions to staff.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
11.
DISCUSS THE SITES ACCEPTABLE TO THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT (HCD) FOR INCLUSION IN THE SIXTH CYCLE HOUSING ELEMENT TO MEET THE CITY’S REGIONAL HOUSING NEEDS ALLOCATION (RHNA)
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council:
1.
Receive a report on the sites acceptable to the State for inclusion in the 6th Cycle Housing Element; and
2.
Direct staff to hold a workshop (Special City Council meeting) to further review the above sites for inclusion in the 6th Cycle Housing Element OR
Approve the sites for inclusion in the 6th Cycle Housing Element and direct staff to submit a completed draft to the State for informal review
Staff Report
Staff Report-Revised
12.
PENSION UPDATE
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council hear a report from the City’s pension consultant, GovInvest, on the status of the City’s pension costs and obligations
Staff Report
13.
PROJECTION OF REVENUE NEEDS
Recommendation: That the City Council provide feedback and recommendations regarding the initial draft of the General Fund Long Range Forecast.
Staff Report
14.
APPROVE AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE AGREEMENT WITH BAY AREA TREE SPECIALISTS TO MODIFY THE TERMS, EXPIRATION, AND COST OF THE FIRE SAFETY WEED ABATEMENT SERVICES AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTVE THE AMENDED AGREEMENT
Recommendation: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Agreement with Bay Area Tree Specialists modifying the terms, expiration, and cost of the fire safety weed abatement services.
Staff Report
15.
CONSIDER THE SECOND AMENDMENT OF THE MOU BETWEEN THE PALOS VERDES PENINSULA UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT AND THE PENINSULA CITIES TO FUND THE SCHOOL RESOURCE OFFICER PROGRAM
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Second Amendment to the MOU (Attachment A) between the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District (PVPUSD) and the Peninsula Cities to fund the School Resource Officer Program.
Staff Report
16.
CONSIDER RESOLUTION NO. R24-03 APPROVING A HIRING INCENTIVE PROGRAM FOR LATERAL POLICE OFFICERS AND ACADEMY GRADUATES
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive information and adopt resolution R24-03 approving a Hiring Incentive Program for Lateral Police Officers and Academy Graduates, not to exceed four hires. MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, reports on community activities, ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
